about: SPEC-serum2 §14.1 (owner I). calib = t_ref(calib): ms of CPU per 1 s of audio for the calibration row (b) through tests/ref-p1 (golden harness scope, 8 voices, see serum-dsp.test.mjs calibRowB), median of 15 unloaded runs on the reference machine; node CPU gates scale their loads by calib / t(calib) measured in the same run. ipad: loads recorded with tests/bench.html (rows d–m; hard ceiling 0.6).

ipad.notes: Rows are median loads (CPU time / real time, one core) over 5 passes. 'worst', 'cold' and q1/q2 are quantized by WebKit's 1 ms performance.now() resolution without cross-origin isolation: 0.375 = one 1 ms tick per 2.667 ms quantum (128 frames at 48 kHz), an upper bound per tick, not a measurement. Device factor vs the node reference rows: 0.38-1.00 (median 0.82): this iPad renders the voice and FX rows at least as fast as the M4 Max reference. Stage 1d iPad baseline (SPEC-canvas §9.1-9.2).
